headline: 9月29日影视速递：爱情假说热，女巫团学院开播
summary: 本周电影热作《爱情假说》领跑，《一击3：最后一击》等受关注；新剧《女巫团学院》《律界战争》首播，热播剧《龙族》《菜鸟老警》持续升温。

industryHighlights.text: 电影热作：《爱情假说》《大学炸弹客》《忘却之岛》《黄金时段》《一击3：最后一击》本周表现亮眼。
industryHighlights.en: Movie heat: The Love Hypothesis, Ted K, The Island of Forgetting, Primetime and One Shot 3: The Final Shot lead this week.

industryHighlights.text: 新剧首播：《女巫团学院》《律界战争》《伊甸之东》本周开播。
industryHighlights.en: New premieres: Coven Academy, Legal War and East of Eden debut this week.

industryHighlights.text: 热播剧：《菜鸟老警》《瑞克和莫蒂》《龙族》《梦魇绝镇》《黑色丽人》持续走热。
industryHighlights.en: Hot series: The Rookie, Rick and Morty, House of the Dragon, From and Black Beauty stay popular.

industryHighlights.text: 待映待播：《复仇者联盟5》《仙逆剧场版：弑仙之战》《幻视任务》《魔女嘉莉》等受期待。
industryHighlights.en: Coming soon: Avengers 5, Xian Ni Movie: Slaying Immortals, Vision Quest and Carrie are highly anticipated.

headlineEn: Sept 29 Screen Digest: Love Hypothesis Hot, Coven Academy Debuts
summaryEn: This week's movie heat is led by The Love Hypothesis, with One Shot 3: The Final Shot also in focus; new series Coven Academy and Legal War premiere, while House of the Dragon and The Rookie stay hot.
